source.label: TheMarketBrew public homepage, visually inspected 2026-09-04 PDT
source.name: Owned current homepage

context.reference_boundary: One owned homepage screenshot and local brand specification; proposed alternatives are not confirmed user preferences
context.product_override: Holdings first, selective information, sustainable light operation

observations.evidence: Soft green haze sits behind the upper left region; warm haze sits lower right.
observations.interpretation: These are decorative atmosphere, not content hierarchy; omit them in the working view.

observations.evidence: Warm near black covers most pixels; green marks the title, active navigation and primary button.
observations.interpretation: Keep green as a scarce functional brand accent.

observations.evidence: The main controls are flat rectangles; the background alone carries blurred color.
observations.interpretation: Favor flat surfaces and thin rules over layered visual effects.

observations.evidence: A centered large headline and button occupy the viewport while the product result is absent.
observations.interpretation: Transfer focal discipline but move the daily result into the first viewport.

observations.evidence: Expressive Chinese headline is paired with small neutral navigation and ample empty margins.
observations.interpretation: Keep expressive type in the brand moment, use readable sans serif for the actual brief.

rules.rule: Use one emerald accent for brand and selection; separate event priority with text and sparse amber.
rules.evidence: Green currently marks title and primary button; task requires distinguishing important information.

rules.rule: Make the most important portfolio change the focal event of the signed in first viewport.
rules.evidence: Current homepage fills the first viewport with a promise rather than a result.

rules.rule: Reserve editorial type for one heading and set Chinese reading text at sixteen to eighteen pixels.
rules.evidence: The current expressive headline coexists with neutral navigation; existing design specification uses sans serif prose.

rules.rule: Use flat planes and thin separators; support quiet and incomplete coverage states explicitly.
rules.evidence: Current interface already uses flat controls; the user asks for fewer features and light operation.

rules.rule: Default to a single reading column on phones and limit the desktop brief to a narrow readable measure.
rules.evidence: Large empty homepage regions show room to prioritize a compact readable service output.

anti_rules: Do not inherit the all-in-one feature inventory.
Do not imply real-time monitoring from a daily batch UI.
Do not add ornamental charts, glow, glass, particles or AI mascots.
Do not treat absent source coverage as an all-clear.
Do not present generated sample events as market facts.
Do not infer permanent user taste from these unselected variants.

protected_elements: Retain only the user's own TheMarketBrew wordmark and brand association.
must_transform: Centered marketing hero must become result-first working layout.
The three concepts use original layouts rather than replicating external trade dress.
